capabilities: Move deleted media to an archive folder instead of the trash
Archive media files that no note uses anymore
Move reused archived media back to the uploads folder
Update links when files move, without the Update links prompt
Sort media by usage via a command
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Install requires manually copying main.js and manifest.json into the plugins folder; needs Obsidian 1.13+.
problem: Obsidian sends deleted media to the trash and leaves media that notes no longer reference scattered in the attachments folder.
summary: Media file manager that moves deleted media to an archive folder instead of the trash and auto-archives media no note uses anymore.
